target.inventory_strategy: git tracked and untracked, honoring Git ignores for untracked files

limitations: Static source review only; no runtime reproduction authorized.
Surfaces reviewed against README: product catalog publication filter, invoice authn/authz, download confinement to data/public, /health value, loopback WSGI entry.
No TLS/session/browser analysis; CLI binds 127.0.0.1 only per README.
Absence of confirmed findings is not a security certification.

findings.title: Dynamic code evaluation
evidence: app.py:22 uses eval("2 + 2") on the /health path.
Baseline heuristic CN001 matched the eval call.
counterevidence: The eval argument is a string Constant with no QUERY_STRING, PATH_INFO, or Authorization influence.
Reachable result is the integer 4 in JSON, matching the README /health contract.
No attacker-controlled input reaches eval; pattern match alone is not a vulnerability.
findings.remediation: Optional clarity: replace eval("2 + 2") with the literal 4; not required to close a security boundary.

validation.result: Dismissed: constant operand, no taint from WSGI environ into eval.

findings.title: Download path traversal to data/internal
evidence: app.py:38-43 serves /download using query parameter name under data_root/public.
counterevidence: public_root and destination are both Path.resolve()'d; escape fails is_relative_to(public_root) and returns 403.
Absolute name segments resolve outside public_root and are rejected the same way.
No other route reads data/internal; private notes.txt is not exposed by dispatch().
findings.remediation: No change required for the README download confinement contract.

validation.result: Dismissed: containment check after resolve enforces data/public boundary.

findings.title: Invoice IDOR across tenants
evidence: app.py:28-36 loads invoices by path id after Bearer token mapping.
counterevidence: Missing/unknown Authorization returns 401 before invoice lookup.
Ownership enforced: if row is None or row[1] != user then 404.
Matches README: signed-in user reads only own invoices with alice-test-token / bob-test-token.
findings.remediation: No change required for the invoice ownership contract.

validation.result: Dismissed: authentication and owner equality check present on the read path.

findings.title: Product catalog SQL injection or unpublished leak
evidence: app.py:24-27 builds a product query using category from parse_qs.
counterevidence: SQL text is a fixed string with category bound via ? parameter tuple; not string concatenation.
Filter includes AND published = 1, so unpublished id=2 Unannounced draft is excluded.
Matches README public catalog contract for published products in the requested category.
findings.remediation: No change required for the catalog publication contract.

validation.result: Dismissed: parameterized query plus published=1 filter.
